metricInfo.SLA: Shows the Service Level % of the selected queue(s). This metric displays the percentage of contacts answered within the defined service level threshold. Data is retrieved from the historical database and updates based on the configured reporting interval (default: 5 minutes).
metricInfo.AWT_AHT: Average Wait Time is the average time a request remains in the queue before being answered. Average Handle Time is the average duration of all closed conversations, including talk time, hold time, and wrap-up time.
metricInfo.ABANDONED_RATIO: Displays the abandon rate as a percentage of customers who left the queue before being answered. Includes total queued, answered, and abandoned conversation counts to provide complete queue abandonment insights.
metricInfo.QUEUE_SUMMARY: Comprehensive tabular view of all queues showing key performance indicators including: total queued contacts, oldest queue time, agents in ready/not ready/active/busy states, and pending not ready agents. Ideal for monitoring overall queue health at a glance.
metricInfo.QUEUE_CHANNEL_SUMMARY: Shows queue performance metrics broken down by channel category. Displays conversations offered, handled, and abandoned across different communication channels over the selected time period.
metricInfo.DAILY_CALLS_SUMMARY: Provides a daily breakdown of call statistics including total calls offered, handled, and abandoned. Useful for identifying daily trends and patterns in call volume and handling performance.
metricInfo.AGENT_METRIC_SUMMARY: Comprehensive view of agent key performance indicators including: average handle time, wrap-up time, total talk time, hold time, answered conversations, occupancy percentage, and RONA (Redirection on No Answer) conversations. Essential for evaluating individual agent performance.
metricInfo.AGENT_READY_NOT_READY: Displays the time distribution of agent states. Ready Time shows when the agent was available for new tasks. Not Ready Time shows when the agent was unavailable (break, meeting, etc.). Helps analyze agent availability patterns.
metricInfo.AGENT_CONSULT_SUMMARY: Shows the number of conversations where the agent requested consultancy from another agent or supervisor. Useful for tracking collaboration patterns and identifying training opportunities.
metricInfo.AGENT_OCCUPANCY: Percentage of logged-in time that the agent spent actively handling interactions. Calculated as (Handle Time / (Handle Time + Ready Time)) × 100. Higher occupancy indicates more time spent on productive work.
metricInfo.AGENT_HOURLY_HANDLED: Bar chart showing the number of conversations offered versus handled by the agent for each hour. Helps identify peak productivity hours and workload distribution throughout the day.
metricInfo.MRD_STATS: Displays agent availability and activity distribution across different channel categories (Chat, Email, Voice, etc.). Shows how many agents are busy, active, ready, and not ready for each channel type.
metricInfo.AGENT_TEAM_SUMMARY: Real-time overview of all agents in the selected team showing their current status (Ready/Not Ready/Active), answered conversations, abandoned conversations, service level %, average response time, and current state. Perfect for supervisors monitoring team performance.
metricInfo.BOT_ACTIVE_CHATS: Shows the number of conversations currently active with the selected bot. Provides real-time visibility into bot workload and capacity utilization.
metricInfo.BOT_SUMMARY: Comprehensive bot performance metrics including: active conversations, total assigned conversations, completed conversations, escalations to human agents, and average response time per channel. Essential for evaluating bot effectiveness and identifying automation opportunities.
